# KAUTUSANG BAYAN SA LAANG-GUGULIN No. 03, Series of 1990

**Appropriation of Funds for School Year 1990**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates the amount of P25,975.28 from the Municipal School Board of Pitogo, Quezon for the school year 1990. The funds are sourced from the Special Education Fund (SEF) and will be used for non-formal education, athletic meets, and repair/maintenance of school buildings and facilities. The ordinance also specifies the allocation of 5/8 of the tax collection for education purposes.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Seksyon 1.** Allocates 5/8 of the tax collection for education purposes, specifically from the special education fund.
2.  **Seksyon 2.** States that the P25,975.28 will be used for non-formal education, athletic meets, and repair/maintenance of school buildings and facilities.
3.  **Seksyon 3.** Refers to the attached "Annex A" for the details of the allocation.
4.  **Seksyon 4.** The ordinance takes effect on July 2, 1990.
